gaps: Every breath-one item treats its precondition as either present or absent. Sorting the pointer's own cases showed two that fit neither: the restaurant's Tuesday night has a price memory, attached to the house instead of the table, and the Western water right has a way to lose it, on the door of forfeiture instead of sale. This produced the changed question for breath two: which preconditions the market makes for itself, which it builds on outside credit, and which it must convert from a hostile form already present.
accepted: Cut to a lot: nothing can carry a price until a quantity of it has an edge, so the Chicago exchange wrote the contract as five thousand bushels before a bushel traded on it, and radio spectrum was the ether until a license was cut as a band times a territory times a term; not a unit of measure, which both already had, but a unit of sale, the piece that changes hands whole.

Grade that erases the farm: one lot can stand in for another only under a rule that says which lots may replace which, so elevator grades let a Chicago buyer take any No. 2 spring wheat instead of the sack he inspected, while every diamond stays its own lot because the four Cs describe stones without letting one substitute for another, and no diamond futures market has ever held; not the unit, which counts, but the substitution rule, which forgets the farm on purpose, and at its far end a table declaring a tonne of methane to be twenty-eight tonnes of carbon dioxide.

Offers on one wall: a price needs a place where two offers for the same lot can be seen at once by someone able to act on either, so trucking became a spot market when load boards put every posted load on one screen, where before the only wall was inside one broker's head and the broker was the market; adjacent to witness-architectures' Room for strangers, but what is compared here expires, so the wall needs a clock and a stale offer on it is a lie.

Thick before it rots: a seller must find a buyer inside the good's shelf life, so the density of arrivals a market needs is set by decay, and the fish auction fixes one hour before dawn to press a day's scattered landings into one crowd; not a headcount but a ratio, arrivals per shelf life, and the fixed hour is the market manufacturing its own thickness out of sparse traffic.

Comps: a new price can be judged only against remembered ones, so a house with no comparable sales cannot be mortgaged and the first lot of any new kind trades on a price imported from a neighboring market or an appraiser; the memory is the one precondition the market makes for itself, but only from its second trade onward, and a memory seeded with wash trades records prices that were never paid.

Delivered absence: when the good sold is an event that did not happen, a tonne not emitted or a forest not cut, delivery can be witnessed only against a baseline of what would otherwise have happened, and nobody observed that, so the lot is a subtraction from a story; the market inherits every weakness of the story's author, and no better sensor helps, since what must be sensed is the absence of the thing.

Finality: a trade exists only from the moment neither party can undo it, so securities settle through a clearinghouse that makes the transfer stick and a house sale stays a relationship until the deed is recorded; there is no market for favors because a favor never settles, and settling one, by naming its price and closing it, would end the relationship it was meant to keep open.

Fence at the lot's edge: a lot can be sold only if third parties can be kept off it, so a fishery has no market in the catch to come until quotas fence the sea, and a spectrum band is a lot only while someone polices interference at its guard band; not the unit but the enforcement of its edge, and the market can draw the line while only a state, a landlord, or a technology can hold it.

Custody out of the maker's hands: the thing must sit somewhere the seller can release it and the buyer can take it without the maker's consent, and a software seat sits in the vendor's activation database, so even after the European court ruled resale of used licenses lawful the used-seat market stayed a rumor because the vendor holds the only shelf; not title, which the buyer may have, but the shelf, and a shelf held by the party who prefers no market is no shelf.

Copy that stays: a sale requires that the seller no longer have the thing, and a dataset sold is a dataset kept, so the buyer pays for a lot the seller still holds and can sell again, and the wanted market for personal data prices at nearly nothing; the cure is to sell access instead of copies, which is a different good with a different custodian.

Door to say no: a price is a price only if either party could have walked, so the ambulance ride has no market and its price is a levy, and a tow from the roadside is priced by statute for the same reason; not monopoly, which still lets the buyer go without, but urgency that removes going without, and a market missing this door is a toll booth however many sellers it has.

Price-proof good: some goods are changed by being paid for, so the priced thing is a different thing, and an apology bought is not an apology, a bought review is an advertisement, a bought vote no longer says what the voter thinks; there is no market for apologies not because a unit, a witness, or a medium is missing but because the good carries its own motive, and this is the one precondition nothing built can supply.

Compelled buyer: a market needs at least one side whose demand is an obligation rather than a wish, as cap-and-trade allowances trade because emitters must surrender them by a date while the voluntary offset market, where nobody must buy, thins and collapses in quality.

Seller's clock: a market needs a party who must sell, as fish must be sold by noon and an estate by probate, so dormant markets are those where every holder can wait forever, as with family art and water held by farmers.

residue.item: Standing quote: someone obliged to name a price at all times, so the market exists between trades (the specialist, the automated market maker).
residue.why: Rejected: a precondition for a continuous market, not for a market at all; periodic auctions are born without one, and the birth-level version of the same need is the fixed hour inside Thick before it rots.

residue.item: Conversion table: a rule declaring two different things the same quantity, as a tonne of methane is declared twenty-eight tonnes of carbon dioxide.
residue.why: Merged into Grade that erases the farm as its far end: a substitution rule across kinds is the same mechanism as a substitution rule across farms, and the carbon case survives inside the grade item.

residue.item: Lemons: a market that vanishes because buyers cannot tell good lots from bad.
residue.why: Merged into Grade that erases the farm as its absence case; the lemons collapse is what the missing substitution rule looks like from the buyer's side, and it adds no new thing to build.

residue.item: Legal permission: the state allowing the trade.
residue.why: Rejected: not a mechanism but a summary of several that are (alienable title, an unbarred medium, a fence a court will hold); each case that lacks permission lacks one of those specifically.
Rejected: decomposes into a witness, a finality, and custody outside the wrong party's hands; nothing named trust has to be built.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a checklist or a partition; a real market needs most of these at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind of precondition.

The seriation is an itinerary of how much of each precondition the market can make for itself, not a ranking of importance, cost, or the order in which a founder should build; map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (Chicago elevator grades, the UsedSoft ruling, offset registries, the 2024 New York reservation law, Western beneficial-use doctrine, Radford's camp and the mackerel economy, indulgences) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the full histories.
Whether a market should exist is outside the list; Money barred and Price-proof good describe what a bar does to a market's shape, not whether the bar is right.
Market deaths and manipulations (cornering, wash trading, delisting) are outside except where they appear as a birth's failure mode, as in Comps and Seller's own witness.

gaps: The changed question yielded three births by conversion (Memory pinned to the house, Queue to hijack, Lose only by waste), one built on outside credit that dies all at once (Seller's own witness), and one that routes around a bar on the medium (Money barred). Sorting repugnance split it in two: a bar on the medium, which a market can route around, and a bar inside the good, which it cannot, and that split is the map's closing adjacency. Compelled buyer and Seller's clock turned out to be one mechanism seen from two sides, a date, and merged into The clock's side, whose discriminator carries what the merge would otherwise lose: which side holds the clock sets which way the price leans. The territory pointer 'market births' stands; the of-sentence now carries the four-way sorting.
accepted: Memory pinned to the house: buyers read a posted price as the seller's promise, so a restaurant that charges more on Saturday than on Tuesday is punished as a cheat while an airline selling the same seat under a different fare class is not; the market for the Tuesday table is born when the memory is pinned to the lot rather than the house, by giving the Tuesday table a name of its own as the fixed-price dinner ticket did; not price memory missing but price memory attached to the wrong object.

Queue to hijack: a good rationed by waiting already has a price in the length of the line, so a market can be born on the queue itself, as reservation resellers priced the tables a restaurant gave away free and made the house the unpaid seller of its own scarcity until New York banned the resale in 2024; adjacent to exchange-ontologies' Priority, which names the good, this names the birth: a market that arrives as a parasite on someone else's rationing and lives only until the host prices the lot or forbids the trade.

Seller's own witness: a market can be born on a delivery only the seller can attest, as indulgences sold remission in a purgatory no buyer would inspect and offsets are verified by registries the seller pays; the market's life is then exactly the witness's credit, and because every lot shares one witness, doubt in one attestation is doubt in all of them at once, so such markets do not thin, they die together.

Lose only by waste: a right that can be lost but not sold is hoarded and used badly, as a Western water right forfeits under beneficial use if left unused yet can rarely be sold across a basin, so the holder's only exit is to spray the water on alfalfa; the way to lose it exists on the wrong door, and the market is born by moving the exit from forfeiture to alienation.

Money barred: when the community forbids cash as the medium, by a warden or by repugnance, the market is born in whatever substitute the parties can hold, and the substitute's properties then govern it, as prisoners settle in mackerel pouches and once settled in cigarettes that were smoked, so the money supply shrank with use, while kidney donors forbidden to sell trade in chains of paired donations whose marketplace is a matching algorithm rather than a price; not a settlement failure but a bar on the medium, which a market can route around.

The clock's side: a market stays dormant until some party cannot wait, and which side holds the clock sets which way the price leans, since the fish must sell by noon and the estate by probate, so the buyer takes his time and the price leans down, while the emitter must surrender allowances by April, so the seller takes hers and the price leans up, and the voluntary offset market, where nobody must do anything, thins to a rumor; not demand or supply, which are wishes, but a date.

residue.item: Compelled buyer and Seller's clock, held separately from breath one.
residue.why: Merged into The clock's side: both are a date imposed from outside that brings a party to the wall, and keeping them apart hid the one thing an operator uses, that the side holding the clock is the side the price leans away from.

residue.item: Wrong-hands custody of the reservation: the restaurant holds the table the reseller sells.
residue.why: Folded into Queue to hijack: the parasite's custody problem is a consequence of the birth on the queue, not a separate precondition, and it is what the host's ban or ticket resolves.

residue.item: The hive's exchange: foragers trading nectar for the colony's care.
residue.why: Rejected: bees cannot refuse, nothing settles, and no offer is compared; a colony is transport, not a market, and the remote case sharpened Door to say no by showing what an exchange without a door is.
Merged: escrow is custody held by a neutral until finality, so it lives between Custody out of the maker's hands and Finality and adds no third thing to build.

residue.item: Invented world in which every good is price-proof, so all trade is in kind and all markets are matching markets.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: it restates Price-proof good at the scale of a whole economy without a mechanism of its own; it needs a reason why in-kind exchange would not also change the good before admission, and the wild priority's apology bond is the small version of that question.

neighbors.separating_case: A cloud backup vendor's monthly statement that your files are stored: the delivery can be attested only by the seller, so it is the seller's own witness and every customer's confidence dies together if the vendor is caught lying, but the good is a present thing, not an absence, and an outside auditor could verify it by asking for one file back. An offset cannot be verified by asking for the tonne back. Delivered absence is about what kind of thing the good is; Seller's own witness is about who is paid to see it, and a present good can suffer the second without the first.

checks.boundary_case: Trust between the parties is out: it is not a thing that must be built but a summary of several that are, and every case where a market is said to lack trust decomposes into a missing witness, a missing finality, or custody held by the wrong party. Willing counterparties are out for the opposite reason: wanting the market is the premise of every case here, not a precondition of trade.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals at Queue to hijack → Memory pinned to the house: once a parasite market has shown the host its price, the host must absorb the market by naming the lot or kill it by decree, and no path keeps the queue and the market together. It shows a loop at Offers on one wall → Comps, where the wall feeds the memory that judges the next price, opened only by a first price imported from outside. It shows a dependency at Delivered absence → Seller's own witness, since a baseline nobody observed can be supplied only by the seller or the seller's hire. It shows an incompatibility at the limit at The clock's side → Door to say no, where the same variable, how long a party can wait, supplies the market's buyer at one value and removes its refusal at another, so the ambulance is the allowance auction with the clock tightened. And it shows a passage between levels at Money barred → Price-proof good, where a bar that could be routed around at the level of the medium becomes, one level down inside the good, a bar nothing can route around.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each admitted item names a distinct thing that must exist and a distinct wanted market whose absence it explains; the strange members (a market born as a parasite on a queue, money that shrinks because it is smoked, a good that is destroyed by its own price, a right that can be lost only by wasting it) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about market design.

next_crossfield_opening: Births by conversion: connect Memory pinned to the house and Lose only by waste with witness-architectures' Ledger that makes the debt and passages-between-levels' The bow that can be withheld; ask which markets exist only because a precondition already present was renamed rather than built, and whether a renaming can be undone once the market has priced it.

gaps: The headline fork was stated as two-way with no third path, and the third path is the commonest real resolution: the host sells the jump itself (paid lanes, priority boarding, the house's own premium slots) and keeps the queue as what gives the jump its price, so the good born is Priority rather than the Tuesday table. The fork survives three-tined in item and edge. Beyond it, the voluntary offset market was leaned on three times as evidence and called a rumor in the third; the used-software case was asserted as a market that never formed when it formed exactly where the shelf was paper; and Door to say no's 'however many sellers it has' failed on bread.
accepted: The clock's side: a market stays dormant until some party cannot wait, and which side holds the clock sets which way the price leans, since the fish must sell by noon and the estate by probate, so the buyer takes his time and the price leans down, while the emitter must surrender allowances by April, so the seller takes hers and the price leans up, and family art, where no holder must ever sell and no buyer must ever buy, has no side for its price to lean away from and stays in the attic; not demand or supply, which are wishes, but a date.

Queue to hijack: a good rationed by waiting already has a price in the length of the line, so a market can be born on the queue itself, as reservation resellers priced the tables a restaurant gave away free and made the house the unpaid seller of its own scarcity until New York banned the resale in 2024; adjacent to exchange-ontologies' Priority, which names the good, and to clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Queue clock, which reads the line as a wait, this reads the line as a price and names the birth: a market that arrives as a parasite on someone else's rationing and lives only until the host prices the lot, sells the jump itself and keeps the queue as what makes the jump worth paying for, or forbids the trade.

Seller's own witness: a market can be born on a delivery only the seller can attest, as indulgences sold remission in a purgatory no buyer would inspect and offsets are verified by auditors the seller hires; the market's life is then exactly the witness's credit, and because every lot shares one witness, doubt in one attestation is doubt in all of them at once, so such markets do not thin lot by lot as a lemons market does but shrink all together, as the offset market did in 2023 when its forest methodology was doubted; adjacent to witness-architectures' Silence priced as guilt, which is the rule that makes the accused build an honest instrument, this names what a market inherits when no such rule was written.

Custody out of the maker's hands: the thing must sit somewhere the seller can release it and the buyer can take it without the maker's consent, and a software seat sits in the vendor's activation database, so even after the European court ruled resale of used licenses lawful a used market formed only for the paper licenses that transfer by document and never for the seats the vendor must switch on, because the vendor holds the only shelf; not title, which the buyer may have, but the shelf, and a shelf held by the party who prefers no market is no shelf.

Comps: a new price can be judged only against remembered ones, so a house with no comparable sales is mortgaged, if at all, on an appraiser's guess, and the first lot of any new kind trades on a price imported from a neighboring market or an appraiser; the memory is the one precondition the market makes for itself, but only from its second trade onward, and a memory seeded with wash trades records prices that were never paid.

Door to say no: a price is a price only if either party could have walked from this trade, to another counterparty or to going without, so the ambulance ride has no market and its price is a levy, and a tow from the roadside is priced by statute for the same reason; monopoly shuts the door to another seller and leaves going without, need shuts going without and leaves the walk to another seller, which is why bread has a market though nobody can go without eating, and only urgency that shuts both doors at once makes a toll booth of the trade, however many sellers exist beyond the next ten minutes.

Money barred: when the community forbids cash as the medium, by a warden or by repugnance, the market is born in whatever substitute the parties can hold, and the substitute's properties then govern it, as prisoners settle in mackerel pouches and once settled in cigarettes that were smoked, so the money supply shrank with use, while kidney donors forbidden to sell trade in chains of paired donations whose marketplace is a matching algorithm rather than a price; not a settlement failure but a bar on the medium, which a market can route around at a cost the substitute sets: a smoked money loses its supply, and a matching algorithm keeps the trade but loses the price.

Price-proof good: some goods are changed by being paid for, so the priced thing is a different thing, and an apology bought is not an apology, a bought review is an advertisement, a bought vote no longer says what the voter thinks; there is no market for apologies not because a unit, a witness, or a medium is missing but because the good carries its own motive, and this is, as far as this map can see, the one precondition nothing built can supply.
limits: The fixed hour in Thick before it rots is more general than its ratio: the frozen-tuna auction keeps the same dawn hour without decay binding, so the hour manufactures thickness for reasons beyond shelf life (critic's note, held as a limit rather than a repair).
seed: A party who can be bound. The of-sentence lists 'a party' among its precondition kinds, but every item's parties are already contract-capable; the map never names the precondition that one side of a wanted market be a thing that can bear an obligation. Markets wanted with a side that cannot be bound, future generations in any long-dated carbon or debt trade, a river granted legal personhood, an unincorporated crowd, a protocol before it has a legal wrapper, are born only when a proxy is deputized to stand for that side, and the proxy's incentives then govern the market the way the substitute medium governs Money barred. It is the trading twin of witness-architectures' Deputized injury, and it is where this map's 'imported' band meets the state most directly.
